title: Degree-counted local splitting at a point of an étale-site object
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be an étale morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-etale-morphism] finite locally free of degree $d\in\mathbf N$ [def-pc-finite-locally-free]. For every object $W\to X$ of the small étale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and $w\in W$, there exist another site object $V$, a site morphism $a:V\to W$, a point $v\in V$ with $a(v)=w$, schemes $D_j$ indexed by $j\in\operatorname{Fin}(d)$, and maps $i_j:D_j\to Y\times_X V$ [def-pc-fibre-product] forming a coproduct cofan. Each $i_j$ is an open and closed immersion [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-closed-immersion], and $i_j$ followed by the projection to $V$ is an isomorphism. The empty index set is allowed.

source.place: Tag 04HN (lemma-finite-etale-etale-local) in etale.tex; geometric-degree count in etale-cohomology.tex, Tag 03SH (section-trace-method) after Definition 03SE

proof.text: Apply finite_etale_etale_local_split to Y×_X W→W at w. Obtain an étale neighbourhood U→W with a point above w and a finite clopen coproduct of pieces projecting isomorphically to U.

Choose an algebraic closure of the residue field at the selected point of U. Base-change fibre-degree invariance and fiberDegree_eq_finrankΓ identify the geometric fibre dimension with d; exists_overIso_sigma_of_isSepClosed splits this fibre into exactly d points. Pull back the given coproduct to this same point; each component is a copy of the field spectrum, which has exactly one point. Hence its index set has cardinality d. The base-changed coproduct has underlying space the disjoint union of the component spaces. Since each component map to Spec Ω is an isomorphism, the projection of this disjoint union to its index set is a bijection. Comparing with the geometric fibre decomposition yields equality of the two finite cardinalities. No base nonemptiness is assumed globally: the distinguished point alone supplies the geometric point.

Reindex the finite set by Fin d, with the universe lift required by Lean. Compose U→W with W→X to obtain V. Pullback pasting transports the coproduct cofan to Y×_X V and preserves the component isomorphisms; the selected point maps to w.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtale_degree_split_at
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) [Etale f]
    (d : ℕ) [f.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfDegree d]
    (W : X.Etale) (w : W.left) :
    ∃ (V : X.Etale) (a : V ⟶ W) (v : V.left),
      a.left v = w ∧
      ∃ (D : ULift.{u} (Fin d) → Scheme.{u}) (i : ∀ j, D j ⟶ pullback f V.hom),
        Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk (pullback f V.hom) i)) ∧
        (∀ j, IsOpenImmersion (i j) ∧ IsClosedImmersion (i j)) ∧
        (∀ j, IsIso (i j ≫ pullback.snd f V.hom))
